meta.attribution: Stellarium sky culture 'modern_rey'; authors: This sky culture used to be for a long time an easy user-installable addon example contributed by Mike Richards. It has been reworked following the 41st reprint and completed with this description by Georg Zotti (CC BY-SA 4.0). Converted to HIP line segments only; no artwork or description images were copied.
meta.conversion_scope: Only constellations[].lines, id and common_name (plus optional common_names star labels) are converted; illustrations, artwork and description text are not copied.
meta.names_scope: Explicit common_names labels take precedence; stars without an explicit label inherit the constellation/asterism name they belong to.
